title: Ten years, recorded as one
whatChanged: A college-access program from 4th grade and a music magnet from 5th. The first résumé compressed both to a year and four. The first deleted time axis.

title: Trumpet, the booth, the crew

title: Rooted, flashed, recovered
whatChanged: Rooted LG and Android phones, flashed custom ROMs found after hours on XDA, jailbroke the iPhone for Cydia tweaks and home-screen animations, backed up firmware, and worked his own way out of a bootloop.

title: The IR blaster
whatChanged: A phone's IR blaster switched on the TV behind the counselor. Verdict: hacking school property. By about fourteen: hardware, OS and application code, all touched.

title: The TI-84
whatChanged: Found, edited and extended TI-BASIC programs on a permitted calculator. Adapting code, years before composing or writing it.

whatChanged: Reached the code layer's door. Empty.

title: prodbynat
whatChanged: From the first collected reference to a working catalog and storefront. Build the whole block, then arrange by subtraction.

title: Freestyle Fridays
whatChanged: A named weekly series with its own After Effects and Photoshop templates. Cadence, not just a catalog.

title: shotbynat
whatChanged: A photography site built to enter a real-estate lane. A small, correct information system, built before the words for it. Opens Motion Tiles, where GENESIS is the real site.

title: The theatre
whatChanged: A bedroom movie theatre at the highest quality, with no subscription. Following that requirement honestly produced a private cloud.

title: The lane was entered
whatChanged: shotbynat carried a cold application into a realty company's process, past the screen to a work sample, delivered early. The room is where it ended.

whatChanged: Milanote, then Anytype, then Notion: the system this capsule is reading from right now.

title: Governance before workloads

title: The year that wasn't missing
whatChanged: The MPC kept running while everything else looked quiet.

title: Not/Nat From This Planet
whatChanged: Projects named for planets and Mars became a name: Not From This Planet. Then an astronaut, and a record that is a planet. This capsule is where that name was heading.

title: The map found the problem
whatChanged: Drew the infrastructure to make it legible. The diagram showed a service sitting outside its boundary, and the machine moved with nothing to set up again.
credit: Started from a public homelab diagram as reference; drawn in draw.io over nine days

title: The 56-Day Sprint
whatChanged: 250+ applications run as an instrumented campaign inside the OS, then audited in public, the failure included.
snippet:
250+ applications. Four interview processes. Zero offers.

The interesting part isn't the zero.
It's where the zeros clustered.
